strategies.creator: Azrael's 15.87 Rule, reverse-engineered from his worksheet

entry: [ausar_pb9] Expected move in SPY points = prior SPY close × (prior VIX close ÷ 15.87 ÷ 100), rounded to 0.1. Map walls at ±1 expected move, shelves at ±0.5, and prior close as the magnet. Below VIX 15, fade the edges. From 15 to 18.5, trade only a same-bar SPY/QQQ break beyond their first-20-minute ranges. Above 18.5, do not fade and halve size. Enter 09:50-11:05 ET; one setup per session.
[em_1587] sleeve-owned (sleeves/em_1587.py)
exit: [ausar_pb9] Break: target the next mapped level; invalidate on a 5-minute close back inside the opening range. Fade: target prior SPY close; exit on a 5-minute close half an expected move beyond the wall. Flat 11:30 ET.
[em_1587] sleeve-owned exit intents
